title: Scaffold cloud/factory worker bundle
description: New cloud/factory/ directory: its own wrangler.toml with a current compatibility_date (unblocking DO SQLite storage and current WebSocket hibernation), an R2 bucket binding for run artifacts, a D1 binding, a placeholder RunRoom Durable Object class registered in migrations (lease logic lands in Phase 1), a health route, and a vitest + @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers test harness mirroring cloud/worker/test. Completely separate from cloud/worker — the factory bundle never imports from or deploys with the ticks.sh worker (D16: ticks.sh never operates the factory). Keep the bundle deployable from day one even though it does almost nothing.
acceptance_criteria: The bundle deploys to a personal Cloudflare account with wrangler deploy and serves its health route. The compatibility date is current at merge time. R2 and D1 bindings resolve in the vitest-pool-workers harness. Nothing in cloud/worker changed. pnpm test passes in cloud/factory.
